title_zh: Issue #33 R2 本机新绑定 P1：冻结 evaluator 的传递依赖未绑定

latest_independent_review.title: Frozen evaluator imports package dependencies outside the bound dependency closure
latest_independent_review.impact: The prepared binding authorizes/imports the same-package settings.py, but that file imports spike5.common and spike5.features and reads config/base_features.json and config/contract.json. The worker's allowed package origins contain only the seven executable_helpers, which omit common.py, features.py, and those configuration files. _load_evaluators therefore raises UNBOUND_FROZEN_PACKAGE_DEPENDENCY before saved-score evaluation can complete. The runner appends durable RUN_STARTED before invoking the monitored worker, so this can consume the new execution and end as CANNOT_CONFIRM.

evidence.detail: The bound settings imports .common and .features and reads config/base_features.json and config/contract.json.
The required executable_helpers closure omits common.py, features.py, and their settings JSON dependencies.
The worker imports the bound settings and metrics, then rejects any spike5.* module whose origin is outside helpers.values(); run_saved_evaluation calls _load_evaluators.
The owner claims zero-debit RUN_STARTED and writes its durable start receipt before passing the worker to the monitor.

resource_smoke.meaning: Software-only RSS backend smoke; not evaluator, score, truth, or model validation.

required_minimal_fix.request: Restore the complete, traceable frozen evaluator dependency closure from the existing producer/evaluator package and validate every dependency identity and allowed origin before RUN_STARTED.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not delete or broaden the worker module-origin allowlist.
Do not create simplified substitute settings.py or reimplement the evaluator.
Do not change metrics, thresholds, labels, TopN, or truth.
Do not claim current files have historical identity when the historical SHA is unavailable.
required_minimal_fix.required_validation: Independent source and binding review must show complete path/SHA closure and prove the missing-module failure is rejected before any durable RUN_STARTED or registry append.

unresolved: Historical SHA identity for common.py, features.py, config/base_features.json, and config/contract.json is unknown.
